saw_lines: Tradespeople buy the cleaner or glove they already know, then reorder it by habit, one job at a time.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a tradesperson decides whether the job matches the product.
Your 9 ads show no proof number, so a new buyer has no reason to trust you. Collect one, like orders shipped, and open the next ads with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 14 Oct 2026
points: None of your 9 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has no reason to trust you over a cheap alternative. Collect one proof number, like orders shipped, and open the next three ads with it.
All 9 ads started within the last 14 days, so none has run long enough to prove itself. Pick one ad to keep and build the next three as variations of it, same opening line, new product or angle.
0 of 9 ads mention an offer, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Give new buyers one reason to act now, like a first order offer, and put it in the first line of three ads.
6 ads say Learn more, 2 say Apply now and 1 says See details, so one buyer gets three asks. Swap Learn more for Shop now on the damage-covered ads, and run the 2 hiring ads as their own campaign.
